channels.name: A+ (TX positive)
channels.purpose: Positive line of the SATA differential transmit pair; 8b/10b-encoded at 1.5 / 3.0 / 6.0 Gbps.
channels.active_levels: AC-coupled, 400-700 mV pp differential (Gen 1/2), reduced with de-emphasis (Gen 3)
channels.idle_level: Electrical Idle when link is in Partial/Slumber/DevSleep

channels.name: A- (TX negative)
channels.purpose: Negative line of the differential transmit pair.

channels.name: B+ (RX positive)
channels.purpose: Positive line of the SATA differential receive pair.
channels.active_levels: AC-coupled, sensed by RX equalizer + CDR

channels.name: B- (RX negative)
channels.purpose: Negative line of the differential receive pair.

channels.name: DEVSLP
channels.purpose: Single-ended digital sideband; HBA asserts HIGH to put device into DevSleep state (AHCI 1.3.1, requires CAP2.SDS=1 + PxDEVSLP.DSP=1).
channels.active_levels: CMOS HIGH (implementation-defined VOH; typ 1.8 V / 3.3 V)
channels.idle_level: LOW driven or tri-state with platform pull-down

channels.name: Activity_LED
channels.purpose: Per-port activity indicator output, available when CAP.SAL=1.

power_pins.name: VCC (HBA)
power_pins.purpose: Core / IO supply for the HBA silicon; per host-bus spec.

power_pins.name: VCC_PHY
power_pins.purpose: Analog supply for SATA PHY; per PHY vendor spec (typ 1.2 V core + 1.8/3.3 V IO).

global_signals.name: PERST# (PCIe Fundamental Reset)
global_signals.purpose: Asserted while main power is unstable; PCIe-style fundamental reset of the HBA.

global_signals.name: REFCLK (PHY)
global_signals.purpose: Reference clock for all SATA port PHYs (typically 100 MHz HCSL or 25 MHz XTAL × PLL).

global_signals.name: GHC.IE (software)
global_signals.purpose: Global Interrupt Enable; gates all per-port interrupt sources into the PCI interrupt line / MSI.

global_signals.name: GHC.HR (software)
global_signals.purpose: HBA Reset; resets all state machines.

ordering_rules.byte_ordering_within_fis: Little-endian within each Dword of a FIS payload (matches the ATA / PCI convention).
ordering_rules.fis_type_byte_position: Byte 0 of the FIS (lowest-addressed byte of Dword 0).
ordering_rules.primitive_dword_order: ALIGN / R_RDY / X_RDY / SOF / EOF / SYNC are 4-byte primitives transmitted with the LSB Dword nibble first via 8b/10b encoding.
ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: Full-duplex on the wire — TX (A+/A-) and RX (B+/B-) operate independently and simultaneously.

dependency_graph.common_rule: All SATA port PHYs share a common reference clock distribution but each port's CDR + elastic buffer + 8b/10b encoder is independent. The AHCI register block in the digital domain reflects each port's PHY state via PxSSTS and accepts state-change requests via PxSCTL / PxCMD.ICC.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: TX direction transmits FISes when X_RDY → R_RDY → SOF → payload → CRC → EOF sequence completes. RX direction receives FISes when SOF detected → payload + CRC verify → EOF → R_OK or R_ERR returned. Data FIS payload flow is gated by DMA Setup / DMA Activate from the device (write) or directly after CFIS (read).

handshake_pairs.name: X_RDY ↔ R_RDY
handshake_pairs.rule: Transmitter sends X_RDY; receiver sends R_RDY when ready; transmitter begins FIS.

handshake_pairs.name: SOF / EOF + CRC
handshake_pairs.rule: FIS framing — SOF opens, payload + 32-bit CRC, EOF closes.

handshake_pairs.name: R_OK / R_ERR
handshake_pairs.rule: Per-FIS reception status returned by receiver.

handshake_pairs.name: HOLD / HOLDA
handshake_pairs.rule: Dword-level flow control inside Data FIS.

handshake_pairs.name: PMREQ_P / PMREQ_S ↔ PMACK / PMNAK
handshake_pairs.rule: Power-management state request and acknowledge primitive pair.

handshake_pairs.name: COMRESET ↔ COMINIT ↔ COMWAKE
handshake_pairs.rule: OOB envelope handshake for link initialization.

handshake_pairs.name: CFIS ↔ D2H Register FIS
handshake_pairs.rule: AHCI-level command/completion: software sets PxCI[slot]; HBA transmits CFIS; device responds with one or more FISes culminating in a D2H Register FIS that clears PxCI[slot].

handshake_pairs.name: PxSACT bit ↔ Set Device Bits FIS
handshake_pairs.rule: NCQ completion: software sets PxSACT[slot]; HBA clears it when SDB FIS arrives with the matching SActive bit.
